approach: Static recompilation of the Xbox 360 binary with ReXGlue, native Linux AppImage with Qt launcher
notes: Linux v1.0 released (AppImage with Qt launcher, ISO import, and graphics, audio and controls settings). The project is in a playable state but still work-in-progress: bugs and crashes may occur, keyboard and mouse support is still in progress, and a gamepad is recommended. No game data is included - supply your own copy.
